trades.title: Will Paramount's takeover of Warner Brothers succeed Before July 2027?
trades.rationale: Re-entry of the May 30/Jun 1 thesis at a better price. Definitive all-cash $31/sh tender offer; HSR expired Feb 19; shareholder vote done; expected close Q3 2026 with ticking fee after Sep 30. Price dropped 85->79 on the Jun 9 UK CMA Phase 1 launch plus Netflix 'scorched-earth' lobbying and Teamsters/political noise. CMA Phase 1 is ~40 working days; even a referral to Phase 2 (+24 weeks) concludes ~Q1-Q2 2027, inside this market's July 2027 resolution buffer. Haircut p_yes 0.92 -> 0.875 for CMA/political risk; edge +9 at 79.

trades.title: When will OpenAI IPO? Before Sep 1, 2026
trades.rationale: NO bet on IPO process mechanics. OpenAI filed a confidential S-1 on May 22 2026; SEC review of confidential filings runs 60-90 days with comment rounds; the earliest realistic public filing is late August with a mid-September listing, and the company itself targets Sep-Nov. A completed IPO before Sep 1 would require an unprecedented compressed review. p_yes ~0.06 vs market 14 -> +7c edge on NO at 87. Hard dated catalyst (the S-1 filing date) rather than opinion.

trades.title: Will Tesla Inc. report above 440000 total production in Q2 2026?
trades.rationale: NO bet backed by Q1 hard data. Q1 2026: produced 408,386, delivered 358,023 -> ~50k unsold inventory built, nearly all Model 3/Y. The rational Q2 move is to hold or cut production to clear inventory, not grow it +8% to >440k. Q2 delivery consensus is 390-420k (mid ~408k); production above 440k against that demand would deepen the glut. Stock -11% in 20d, below both MAs, confirming soft demand. Risk: affordable-model/robotaxi line ramp keeps gross production high regardless of inventory.

trades.title: How many launches will SpaceX have in June 2026? (above 14)
trades.rationale: Small YES on launch cadence. Falcon family count went 64 (May 30) -> 68 (Jun 8): ~4 June launches in 8 days, an ~0.5/day pace that lands right at ~15 by month-end vs the >14 bar. The back half of June is dense: NRO Jun 18, Globalstar NET Jun 20, AST SpaceMobile Jun 17, plus routine Starlink batches - and SpaceX historically back-loads months. Scrub/weather lumpiness keeps confidence low, but 19c materially underprices a near-coin-flip. Sized smallest of the book accordingly.
